title: 壇上が辞任する

candidates.headline: 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17
candidates.angle: Turn the idea of a brief, unstable tenure into a visual role-reversal: the institutional platform (the podium) literally quits the person it is supposed to empower.
candidates.title: 壇上が辞任する
candidates.scene: White House briefing room. A suited press secretary stands frozen at a microphone stand while the wooden briefing podium rises, slips into the secretary’s chair, grabs a small suitcase, and strides out of the room. The human is left standing empty-handed where the podium once steadied them; a scattering of briefing papers blows behind the departing podium.
candidates.reason: 就任5日で辞任という短さを、発言の場（壇上）が本人を置いて去るという逆転で示す。
candidates.visualTurn: Role reversal: the inanimate podium becomes the active agent that abandons the human holder of the office — the platform quits its person.
candidates.contradiction: The podium is supposed to give a person authority and voice; here the platform itself walks away, leaving the official without the office.
candidates.evidence: 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17

evaluation.reason: 非常に直接的な逆転（壇上が人を見捨てる）で、見た瞬間に機能と役割の矛盾が読める。道具（壇上）を擬人化して出て行かせる表現は印刷小寸（64mm）でも主役の輪郭と動きで伝わりやすい。英語の大きな単語“PRESS”は一語なので許容範囲。特定の原因や非公開情報を付加していないため根拠も良好。

candidates.headline: 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17
candidates.angle: Make the fleeting tenure literal by revealing that the press secretary is not a durable person but a timepiece whose sand has almost run out.
candidates.title: 素顔が砂時計
candidates.scene: At the podium a newly appointed press secretary reaches up and peels off their face like a mask; beneath the removed face their torso is a clear hourglass with almost all the sand in the lower bulb and just a few grains left in the top. A small trickle of sand falls onto the floor between the secretary and the microphone.
candidates.reason: 短期の辞任を、担当者の身体を時間切れの砂時計として暴露する描写で表す。
candidates.visualTurn: Reveal: the apparent human is exposed as a literal hourglass whose time is nearly spent, turning tenure into an object with a visible expiration.
candidates.contradiction: A spokesperson should be a steady human presence; visually they are shown as a transient timing device whose sand has run out.
candidates.evidence: 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17

evaluation.reason: 顔を剥がして中身が砂時計であると暴く“暴露”型の仕掛けは皮肉が強く、就任5日で辞任という事実を直接的に可視化する。視覚的驚きは高いが、64mmの小さい印刷では砂粒や上下の砂の差を判別しにくく、細部表現に頼るため小フォーマットでの識別性がやや落ちる。題はやや詩的だが関連性は明確。

candidates.headline: 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17
candidates.angle: Exaggerate the small number ‘5’ into an overwhelming physical force that ejects the official — the tenure becomes a dominating object.
candidates.title: 巨大な5に押し出される
candidates.scene: Inside the press briefing room a small, stunned press secretary is being shoved off the podium by an enormous tear-off calendar page shaped as a bulky numeral five that fills the doorway; the oversized page physically pushes the secretary toward the exit while loose briefing notes scatter to the floor.
candidates.reason: 「5日」という数字を物理的に巨大化させ、わずかな在任期間が人を圧倒して追い出す光景にする。
candidates.visualTurn: Scale shift: the numeral 5 is dramatically enlarged and acts like an eviction force, reversing expected proportions between a person and a date.
candidates.contradiction: Rather than the person occupying a job, the tiny human is dominated and expelled by the tiny-length number turned huge — the short tenure itself does the firing.
candidates.evidence: 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17

evaluation.reason: 数字「5」を巨大化して人を押し出すスケール逆転は経済的で即読めるヴィジュアル。小さな版面でも数字一つで主旨が伝わり、図像の整理も容易。驚き度・新規性は他案よりやや平凡だが、可読性と制作実務上の安定性は高い。事実以上の因果や動機を追加していないため根拠は良好。

exploredCandidates.evidence: 就任からわずか5日で辞任

exploredCandidates.headline: 3. 気象庁、緊急地震速報を誤り取り消し M9.9と過大予測、各地で混乱（時事、Yahoo!）2026/10/17
exploredCandidates.angle: A warning system that should reduce harm instead becomes the visible source of chaos when its false alarm escalates panic.
exploredCandidates.title: 警報が暴れる

The ground beneath remains calm—no actual quake cracks are visible—only the alarm's heavy footsteps creating damage.
exploredCandidates.reason: 警告の“安全を守る”役割が誤報で逆に混乱と被害を生んだ点を皮肉るため。
exploredCandidates.visualTurn: The warning device that should only signal danger is shown causing the destruction and panic itself.
exploredCandidates.contradiction: An agency device designed to protect people by warning them becomes the visible cause of chaos when its false alert overstates danger.
exploredCandidates.evidence: 緊急地震速報を誤り取り消し M9.9と過大予測

exploredCandidates.angle: Software promised to define and update vehicles becomes dramatically smaller than the hulking cars it controls—where tiny code looms larger than hardware.
exploredCandidates.title: ソフトが運転する

exploredCandidates.visualTurn: A small app icon (software) physically puppeteers a giant car, reversing expected scale and control.
exploredCandidates.contradiction: The software that is supposed to be an invisible upgrade is depicted as a tiny object actually controlling a huge physical vehicle.
exploredCandidates.evidence: 全50車種をSDVに 独自ソフトで性能向上

exploredCandidates.headline: 6. AI関連株に売り継続、米国株は反落 コアウィーブ12％安（ロイター、日経、Yahoo!）2026/10/17
exploredCandidates.angle: The AI hype that attracted cash now visibly hands investors the opposite of promise—outright sell signals instead of returns.
exploredCandidates.title: 信仰が裏返る
exploredCandidates.scene: A shrine-like golden 'AI' idol sits on a pedestal; an investor kneels to insert coins into an offering box, but the idol mechanically dispenses stamped paper tickets that read 'SELL' which flutter back toward the kneeling investor like change. exploredCandidates.reason: 投資の呼び水である“AIブーム”が、実際には資金の逆流を返している矛盾を可視化するため。

exploredCandidates.contradiction: The AI boom that drew investor money is shown mechanically returning 'sell' tickets—turning attraction into rejection.
exploredCandidates.evidence: AI関連株に売り継続、米国株は反落

exploredCandidates.headline: 4. ニデック、永守氏・岸田氏ら歴代5社長に賠償責任、会計不正で報告書を受領（日経、時事）2026/10/17
exploredCandidates.angle: A company famed for precision motors and engineering has its instruments of accuracy visually turned into the devices that shred its own accounts—precision used to dismantle bookkeeping.
exploredCandidates.title: 精密が帳尻を壊す
exploredCandidates.scene: A single huge, gleaming electric motor (Nidec's signature product) occupies the stage; its perfectly meshed gears are chewing a stack of balance sheets and spitting out shredded ledgers and a stamped notice that reads 'LIABILITY.' exploredCandidates.reason: 精密機器を製造する企業の“精密”というイメージと会計不正という結果の落差を描くため。

exploredCandidates.contradiction: The engineering precision associated with the company is shown physically producing the destruction of its own accounting records.
exploredCandidates.evidence: 歴代5社長に賠償責任、会計不正で報告書を受領

evaluations.headline: 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17
evaluations.reason: 発表・説明を担う役割（報道官）が、文字どおり“発表する場”から逃げ去るという単純明快な役割反転を描く案。視覚転換ははっきりしており、ポディウム＝拡声と説明の場所が脱出用ハッチになるという対比が一目で読める強みがある。弱点は比喩自体がやや定番（「逃げる」表現）になり得る点だが、素材が少人数で小サイズ向きなので紙面や小さいフォーマットでも効く。

evaluations.headline: 3. 気象庁、緊急地震速報を誤り取り消し M9.9と過大予測、各地で混乱（時事、Yahoo!）2026/10/17
evaluations.reason: 警報機が『危険を知らせるだけ』のはずが、誤報によって実際に混乱・被害を生んでしまったという逆説を直截に示す案。警報器が踏みつけて町を壊すビジュアルは即効性があり、タイトルなしでも状況の逆転が伝わる。弱点は“警報が物理的に暴れる”という寓意がやや大袈裟に映る可能性がある点だが、元のニュースが混乱を伝えているため表現は妥当。

evaluations.headline: 8. トヨタ、全50車種をSDVに 独自ソフトで性能向上 30年までに年1000万台（日経、Yahoo!）2026/10/17
evaluations.reason: 『ソフトウェア定義車（SDV）』という抽象的な概念を、スケール逆転（小さなソフトが巨大な車を操る）で可視化する案。視覚的にはわかりやすく驚きもあるが、元見出し自体に“言動の矛盾”は強くないため本質的な皮肉度は低め。小さなフォーマットでは車の“大きさ”を描き切れないことがある点が弱み。ニュースの事実（SDV化方針）は裏取り済みで、比喩の範囲内に留めているため過度な推測は含まない。

evaluations.headline: 6. AI関連株に売り継続、米国株は反落 コアウィーブ12％安（ロイター、日経、Yahoo!）2026/10/17
evaluations.reason: 『AIブームが資金を呼ぶ』という期待が、実際は資金の逆流（売り）になって返ってきているという逆転を、供物（投資）を返す偶像という一コマで表す案。構図が簡潔で小さな欄でも読みやすく、メッセージ性が強い。弱点は『偶像／礼拝』メタファーが使い古された感がある点だが、売り札が直接返ってくる仕掛けは視覚的な鮮度が高い。

evaluations.headline: 4. ニデック、永守氏・岸田氏ら歴代5社長に賠償責任、会計不正で報告書を受領（日経、時事）2026/10/17
evaluations.reason: 『精密』を代名詞とする製品が、逆に帳簿を粉砕してしまうという役割逆転の比喩は強い。モーターがバランスシートを噛み砕く図は一見して意外性があり、企業イメージとのギャップを際立たせる。弱点は、視覚表現が『物理的な帳簿破棄』を想起させやすく、元見出しは会計不正と賠償責任を伝えるに留まるため“証拠隠滅”など具体的な不正行為を示唆してしまう恐れがある点。したがって表現は比喩に留める必要があり、そこがグラウンディングを下げる要因となる（下記に未裏付けの前提を列挙）。
unsupportedClaims: モーターが実際に会社の帳簿を物理的に破壊したという描写（証拠隠滅等の具体的行為）は見出しに裏付けがない

顔を剥がして中身が砂時計であると暴く“暴露”型の仕掛けは皮肉が強く、就任5日で辞任という事実を直接的に可視化する。視覚的驚きは高いが、64mmの小さい印刷では砂粒や上下の砂の差を判別しにくく、細部表現に頼るため小フォーマットでの識別性がやや落ちる。題はやや詩的だが関連性は明確。
数字「5」を巨大化して人を押し出すスケール逆転は経済的で即読めるヴィジュアル。小さな版面でも数字一つで主旨が伝わり、図像の整理も容易。驚き度・新規性は他案よりやや平凡だが、可読性と制作実務上の安定性は高い。事実以上の因果や動機を追加していないため根拠は良好。

paperArticleTitle: 米報道官、就任5日で辞任
prompt:
Create a single editorial cartoon for English-speaking newspaper readers.
News headline (source evidence, not lettering): 1. 米ホワイトハウス報道官、就任からわずか5日で辞任（ロイター、BBC、NYタイムズ等）2026/10/17
Satirical angle: Turn the idea of a brief, unstable tenure into a visual role-reversal: the institutional platform (the podium) literally quits the person it is supposed to empower.
Scene: White House briefing room. A suited press secretary stands frozen at a microphone stand while the wooden briefing podium rises, slips into the secretary’s chair, grabs a small suitcase, and strides out of the room. The human is left standing empty-handed where the podium once steadied them; a scattering of briefing papers blows behind the departing podium.
Visual turn to show in the drawing: Role reversal: the inanimate podium becomes the active agent that abandons the human holder of the office — the platform quits its person.
Depict this visible ironic reversal, not a literal reenactment of the reported event or a generic portrait. The turn must read without the title. A metaphor must not assert an unreported action or guilt.
Deliver the illustration alone. The page layout adds its title separately as real text. Do not render any title, subtitle, caption, heading or footer anywhere in this image, including the white margins. Do not write any Japanese characters in the image. Do not add text beneath the figures.
Strongly reference the pen-and-ink editorial cartoon work of Georges Bigot, Charles Wirgman and Charles Keene: observant human caricature, expressive faces and gestures, lively economical contours with deliberate changes in line weight, convincing clothing folds, and sparse hand-drawn hatching. Make these nineteenth-century draughtsmen the primary visual references throughout the drawing.
Create the original artwork for a newspaper illustration that will be printed using letterpress equipment and techniques from 150 years ago, circa 1876. Draw a deliberately composed, human-looking pen-and-ink original for an engraver to turn into a relief printing block. Use economical, clearly separated lines that remain legible when printed at small column size. Deliver the clean original drawing, without simulated aged-paper or printed-ink texture. Specific recognizable characters, expressive caricature, one clear visual joke, spare composition, natural asymmetry, varied purposeful contour lines. Avoid generic AI illustration conventions, glossy perfection, decorative clutter, stock robot imagery unless the joke specifically needs it, and irrelevant objects.
Black ink strokes on pure white paper ONLY. Clear outlines; express every shadow with sparse hatching, cross-hatching or stippled marks. Leave white paper visible between strokes. No gray fills, gradients, smooth shading, color, digital painting, photorealism, artificial paper texture or engraving filter effect. Keep most areas unshaded. Compact square composition, width:height exactly 1:1, complete subjects within the frame.
Design for a small newspaper column only about 64 mm wide. Use one clear visual joke with no more than two main figures and one essential prop. Remove secondary people, inset maps, small labels and ornamental detail. Render exactly one text element in the ENTIRE image: PRESS. Use bold, clean uppercase English capitals on ONE major prop. Each letter must be at least 15% of the full image height, and the word must occupy at least 30% of the image width. Make the sign physically large in the scene, never a small stamp, badge, chart, screen, speech bubble or distant billboard. If this cannot fit naturally, simplify the prop and composition to make room. No other letters, numbers or pseudo-text anywhere. Ignore ALL label or written-word instructions implicit in the headline, angle and scene except the one specified text element above. Never use fine print or tiny characters. Do NOT draw the Japanese title, a caption, a border, watermark or signature inside the image; the title will be typeset separately outside the artwork. Treat the scene as satire, and do not invent additional factual allegations beyond the supplied headline.
